title: Bariatric surgery coverage, NCD 100.1 as operationalized by Noridian Jurisdiction F
compiled_by: T-01, hand-compiled from the T-02 corpus

jurisdiction.note: Every quantified constant below comes from A53028, not from CMS. NCD 100.1 quantifies nothing. A different MAC is a different tree over the same NCD (D21).

decision_expression: a AND b AND c1 AND c2 AND c3 AND c4 AND c5

criteria.label: BMI at or above the coverage threshold

source.quote: the patient must have a body-mass index (BMI) ≥ 35

bmi_threshold.note: Inclusive. E12 pins the 35.0 boundary as MET.

lookback_months.note: REQ-11 evaluates (a) against the most recent BMI observation within a lookback window. Neither source document defines one. A53028's only windows are the 12 months for program participation and six months for the multidisciplinary evaluation, and neither governs the BMI measurement. T-13 must not invent a default.

national_floor.quote: are covered for Medicare beneficiaries who have a body-mass index ≥ 35, have at least one co-morbidity related to obesity, and have been previously unsuccessful with medical treatment for obesity.

criteria.label: At least one co-morbidity related to obesity

source.quote: at least one co-morbidity related to obesity. Further

value_set_id.note: Referenced, not inlined. A53028's Group 1 holds 543 ICD-10-CM codes; T-05 builds and verifies the set against real codes. Inlining it would make every diff of this file unreviewable (D3, D23).

criteria.label: A physician-supervised weight management program is documented

source.quote: in a weight-management program that is supervised by a physician or other health care professionals

min_events.note: Existence check. REQ-9 already excludes unsupervised attempts at extraction, so membership in wm_events is the supervision claim (REQ-36, D13). Zero events is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, never NOT_MET.

criteria.label: The qualifying run is recent enough

source.quote: within the last 12 months prior to bariatric surgery

recency_window_months.note: Answers spec open question 2. REQ-32 forbids hardcoding it; this entry is where it lives.

criteria.label: The program ran for a minimum number of consecutive months

source.quote: for a minimum of four consecutive months

min_consecutive_months.note: REQ-14 buckets event dates by calendar month and takes the longest run of consecutive populated months. A run of one to three months is NOT_MET; zero events is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

criteria.label: BMI documented in every month of the qualifying run

source.quote: The weight-management program must include monthly documentation of patient’s weight and BMI, current dietary regimen and physical activity (e.g. exercise program).

documentation_rate.note: REQ-40. A documented BMI, not one derived from a weight plus an on-file height — a derived value has no single span to cite (D15).

criteria.label: Diet and activity documented across the qualifying run

source.quote: The weight-management program must include monthly documentation of patient’s weight and BMI, current dietary regimen and physical activity (e.g. exercise program).

c5_min_documented_events.note: The value is monthly documentation across c3's four-month minimum run, so at the minimum run length it is exact. Above it the constant is a floor where the source states a rate, which is permissive in the false-MET direction. The same sentence is rendered per-month for c4 (REQ-40) and as a count here (REQ-37); one sentence, two shapes. T-37 reconciles them (D23).

source.quote: The weight-management program must include monthly documentation of patient’s weight and BMI, current dietary regimen and physical activity (e.g. exercise program).

requires_both_diet_and_activity.note: One sentence requires both, so c5 counts an event only when diet_documented and activity_documented are both true (REQ-38).

source.quote: Physician-supervised programs consisting exclusively of pharmacological management are not sufficient to meet this requirement.

pharmacological_management_alone_insuffi.note: Recorded because it is policy, and dropped constants are how a tree drifts from its source. No predicate consumes it at v1; a program that is exclusively pharmacological is not distinguishable from wm_events alone.

discrepancy_tolerance.note: REQ-39 records a disagreement only at or beyond this tolerance, and D14 is explicit that a structured 38.1 against a note 38.0 is a rounding artifact while 38.1 against 45 is the case the list exists for. No source text bounds it — it is a judgment about what wastes a reviewer's attention, not a coverage rule. T-33 must not supply its own default.

reconciled_facts.note: REQ-34: the structured value is authoritative and the disagreement is advisory, unless the two fall on opposite sides of bmi_threshold, in which case the criterion resolves INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with gap_reason SOURCE_CONFLICT (D11).
